items.title: Strategy, Metaplanet face MSCI exclusion Risk: What it means for crypto
items.summary: Scott Melker details how MSCI's proposal to exclude 'non-operating' asset-holding companies could trigger forced sell-offs for Strategy (MSTR) Inc. , Metaplanet, and Yellow Cake, setting a risky precedent for the bitcoin treasury model.
